title: Detailed toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shadow under block -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2a1846'/>
  
  <!-- Left face (side) of block - darker shade of red -->
  <polygon points='20,38 20,74 50,84 50,48' fill='#a01830'/>
  
  <!-- Right face (side) of block - medium red -->
  <polygon points='50,48 50,84 82,72 82,36' fill='#c8203c'/>
  
  <!-- Top face of block - bright red -->
  <polygon points='50,12 82,36 50,48 20,38' fill='#ef2846'/>
  
  <!-- Top face lighter edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,12 82,36 50,48 20,38' fill='#ff5a6e' opacity='0.25'/>
  
  <!-- Stud 1 on top (left-back) - cylinder -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='22' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ff5a6e'/>
  <rect x='31' y='22' width='18' height='4' rx='0' fill='#d81e3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='27' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#b81630'/>
  
  <!-- Stud 2 on top (right-back) -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ff5a6e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='26' width='18' height='4' fill='#d81e3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='31' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#b81630'/>
  
  <!-- Stud 3 on top (front) -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='34' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ff5a6e'/>
  <rect x='36' y='34' width='18' height='4' fill='#d81e3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='39' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#b81630'/>
  
  <!-- Front-face decoration: white square panel -->
  <polygon points='30,56 30,74 44,78 44,60' fill='#fff0d8'/>
  <polygon points='44,60 44,78 56,74 56,56' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  
  <!-- Face on front panel: two eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='65' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2a1846'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='65' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2a1846'/>
  
  <!-- Face smile -->
  <path d='M35 70 Q40 75 43 73 Q47 71 49 70' stroke='#2a1846' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Side face bright circle -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='58' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ff8ba0'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='58' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffd0d8'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom edge accent -->
  <polygon points='20,74 50,84 82,72 82,75 50,87 20,77' fill='#7a0c22'/>
</svg>
